# TwincitySpa

> TwincitySpa is a luxury massage and spa centre located in Bahria Town Phase 7, Rawalpindi, Pakistan. It offers professional massage and wellness treatments only, and welcomes guests from Bahria Town, DHA Islamabad, Rawalpindi and Islamabad. It has one location (Bahria Town Phase 7) and no other branches.

Contact: phone/WhatsApp +92 314 3100149 (0314 3100149) · email info@twincityspa.com · https://twincityspa.com
Booking: WhatsApp (https://wa.me/923143100149), phone, or the booking request form. Appointments are confirmed only when the TwincitySpa team replies.
Prices: every treatment is PKR 3,000 for 30 minutes or PKR 6,000 for 1 hour. Opening hours: every day, 12:00 PM (noon) to 5:00 AM.
